name: MonarchRadioRow
title: RadioGroup
summary: The Monarch radio: a 16dp ring with a 10dp accent dot inside a 48dp touch target, with an optional label; MonarchRadioGroup reads the radios as one group.
whenToUse: For one choice out of two to five options that are all visible.
whenNotToUse: For more options use a Material 3 menu. For independent options use checkboxes.
api: @Composable fun MonarchRadio(selected: Boolean, onClick: (() -> Unit)?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, invalid: Boolean = false, label: String? = null, description: String? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)
@Composable fun MonarchRadioGroup(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, label: String? = null, content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)
@Composable fun MonarchRadioRow(selected: Boolean, onClick: () -> Unit, label: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, description: String? = null)

options.name: onClick
options.description: Called when the user chooses it; null draws the ring only.

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label; the whole row selects.

options.name: enabled
options.description: A disabled control is drawn at half opacity and ignores input.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the press and focus interactions.

states.name: selected
states.description: The control is filled with the strong accent.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Disabled control and the disabled text color; announced as disabled.

states.name: focused
states.description: The focus ring around the row.

appearance: The selected button is drawn in the strong accent in every theme; an unselected one in the muted text color.
platformNotes: Replaces the Material 3 RadioButton (20dp, 2dp ring). Same behaviour: selectable with Role.RadioButton; MonarchRadioGroup adds selectableGroup so TalkBack says "1 of 3". The dot is 10dp inside a 16dp ring (the web draws about 8dp). Migrating: RadioButton(selected, onClick) becomes MonarchRadio(selected, onClick); drop colors.
accessibility: The row is one TalkBack element with the radio button role, the label and the selected state.
Rows inside Modifier.selectableGroup() are announced as one group, with their position.
The whole row is the touch target and is at least 48dp high.
A disabled row is announced as disabled.
edgeCases: Without selectableGroup the rows still work, but TalkBack does not announce the position in the group.
Selecting the selected row calls onClick again; the app decides whether that changes anything.

examples.title: Options with descriptions
examples.template:
MonarchRadioGroup(label = {{label}}) {
    MonarchRadioRow(
        selected = selected == {{options.0.value}},
        onClick = { selected = {{options.0.value}} },
        label = {{options.0.label}},
        description = {{options.0.description}},
    )
    MonarchRadioRow(
        selected = selected == {{options.1.value}},
        onClick = { selected = {{options.1.value}} },
        label = {{options.1.label}},
        description = {{options.1.description}},
    )
    MonarchRadioRow(
        selected = selected == {{options.2.value}},
        onClick = { selected = {{options.2.value}} },
        label = {{options.2.label}},
        description = {{options.2.description}},
        enabled = !{{options.2.disabled}},
    )
}
examples.code:
MonarchRadioGroup(label = "Workspace visibility") {
    MonarchRadioRow(
        selected = selected == "members",
        onClick = { selected = "members" },
        label = "Members only",
        description = "Only people you invite can see this workspace.",
    )
    MonarchRadioRow(
        selected = selected == "organization",
        onClick = { selected = "organization" },
        label = "Whole organization",
        description = "Anyone in your organization can find and join it.",
    )
    MonarchRadioRow(
        selected = selected == "public",
        onClick = { selected = "public" },
        label = "Public link",
        description = "Anyone with the link can view it.",
        enabled = !true,
    )
}
